rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously mentioned reality
compound object of knowing; gūḍha qualifies sadbhāva
abstract state that comes into being
main verb indicating the emergence of omniscience

items.question: What state arises from knowing that hidden true nature?
premises: There is a hidden true nature to be known.
Knowing that hidden true nature is a prior act.
All-knowingness is presented as a resulting state.
items.inference: Therefore, knowing the hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taṃ depends on the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
